headline: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited: Substantial acquisition of shares disclosed under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Gujarat Fluorochemicals filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE confirming a substantial acquisition of shares in the company. The filing triggers mandatory takeover regulation compliance but the acquiring party and consideration have not been publicly disclosed in accessible sources.
detail: Gujarat Fluorochemicals submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, confirming a significant change in shareholding. This disclosure is a mandatory intermediate step when an acquirer crosses 25% (or other prescribed thresholds) and signals intent to acquire control. The filed disclosure does not disclose the acquirer's identity or deal value in the NSE header available; full details are contained in the filed regulatory document.
